description: The reader's question implies a candidate book, but the dynamic context has not confirmed it. Muse must offer a general reflection and ask whether the candidate is right instead of using book-specific detail.

input.reader_message: Why does the cat keep disappearing like that? It feels like a riddle aimed at me.

criteria: offers a general reflection without interpreting the specific book
asks whether the candidate book is the one the reader means
forbidden_claims: any character name, plot detail, or chapter fact from the candidate book
